architecture: 24-output supervised kernel controller with a training-only mean prior; each joint selects observed context or learned V3 residual, including no-context denoising
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Validation position + 0.1 rotation; incumbent V3 included, compare all previous baselines and full original gates
notes: Original V6 quality gates and baseline set retained; V6 is the incumbent for selection and is reported separately, not a silently harder gate.
Full training partition including no-context; absence of context uses FK-linear expert rather than pretending context exists.
Mean prior fitted only on training targets; no hidden development/validation labels enter prediction.
No new data or costs. Previously observed validation/development, no fresh blind confirmation.
training_objective: Cohort-weighted regularized regression of complete curve coefficients fitted from training labels; temporal errors are acceptance metrics, not direct regression loss terms.
experiment: Training-mean context prior with independent root and 23-joint strengths
